The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, why Collabrios, why now

Collabrios owns the hardest, most valuable part: the technology backbone that keeps PACE programs running — EHR, care management, and now AI analytics for frail-elder care. But that only scales as fast as you can onboard each program's clinical, pharmacy, enrollment and provider data across settings and CMS/Medicaid. Vorro (BridgeGate EiPaaS) sits underneath as the integration layer: HL7, FHIR, X12 (834/820/837), NCPDP and ADT in; normalized, reconciled streams out; results written back.

The highest-leverage moment is now, with Collabrios Intelligence launching and PACE expanding — every program onboarded in days pulls value forward.

Not a competing product; the plumbing that makes every PACE program and data source a connector, not a project. The platform stays Collabrios's; any-to-any movement of the data is Vorro.
